name: Segment: by Points, Box or Words
description: Cuts objects out of a picture as a mask. Segment by Points or Box: SAM 2.1 (code and checkpoints Apache-2.0, github.com/facebookresearch/sam2; the ONNX export is by vietanhdev, Apache-2.0). Find by Text: GroundingDINO tiny (code and weights Apache-2.0, github.com/IDEA-Research/GroundingDINO; the ONNX export is onnx-community's, Apache-2.0) gives a box for what words name, which Segment turns into a mask. Both run through ONNX Runtime (MIT), on the CPU or an NVIDIA GPU, in the pack's own Python environment. Nothing is bundled but the tokenizer's word list (BERT uncased, Apache-2.0): the models are downloaded from the model picker after a question that names their licence.

setup.description: Create the pack's Python environment (ONNX Runtime for the CPU, NumPy, Pillow) in its folder; needs uv and the network.
